name: html-inline-button-in-paragraph-becomes-native
description: A paragraph carrying one text-only inline <button> with no form or runtime-behavior semantics converts to editable core/paragraph RichText instead of freezing the whole line as core/html. The control rides through inline, the same way an anchor already does, so it stays reachable and labelled.

source_reference.notes: Regression fixture for a base44 React SPA import (posts/page-sellerregister.post_content, selector p.text-center.text-xs.text-muted-foreground): 'Already a seller? <button>Sign in</button>' degraded to core/html, the only quality-gate failure on that source (fallback_count: 0, core_html_block_count: 1).

legacy_comparison.reason: New native inline-button-in-paragraph behavior has no legacy equivalent.

input.content: Already a seller?

expect.value: Already a seller?
